entries.34f58ec2e0738055: As its medium-term management strategy, it sets out completing structural reform and promoting growth strategies. In the domestic business, it will establish the new format “New Combo Store Model” and convert existing stores, and work toward realizing “No.1 in food safety and security” through thorough measures to prevent recurrence following labeling irregularities in handmade rice balls and other products, and by strengthening hygiene management systems. In its growth strategy, it aims to develop its workplace business and its Vietnam business as new pillars, and it sets improving the revenue of each franchise store as its top management priority.
